subject: DeepGrid Semi
lens: product — the AI functions DeepGrid's perception layer performs and sells
bounding_statement: DeepGrid sells a bounded camera-perception subsystem inside an accountable integrator's safety case. It does not own brake actuation, calibration, homologation or warranty, and no use case below may be written as if it does.

use_cases.arena: Segment B · OEM line-fit via braking Tier-1 attach
use_cases.dates: 1 Jan 2027 new models · 1 Oct 2027 all models
use_cases.title: Sell the braking Tier-1 the object list its safety case needs — never the brake decision
use_cases.challenge: Rule 96(12) obliges AEBS plus Vehicle Stability Function on M2/M3/N2/N3 from 1 Jan 2027. The system must warn at least 1.4 s before it brakes and may not enter the emergency phase before TTC 3.0 s. That budget is a perception problem; the braking is not. In the only FIR-level Indian crash dataset published, trucks were the most common impacting vehicle at 30%.
use_cases.solution: DGS001 supplies detection, classification, tracking and per-target TTC on a documented interface, with confidence and sensor-health state. Actuation, calibration, homologation and warranty stay with the Tier-1 — that division is what makes the sale possible, and abandoning it is what makes it impossible.
how: Forward camera into DGS001: detect and classify car, truck, bus, two- and three-wheeler, pedestrian and animal from 25 km/h to max design speed, at every load state
Track each target, estimate range-rate, compute per-target TTC and in-path probability
Emit a ranked object list with per-object confidence and a degradation state on the interface the Tier-1 specifies
Tier-1 arbitrates the warning cascade and owns the braking decision and its safety case
stats: one haptic/acoustic mode, then two, before braking
the emergency phase may not start sooner
the N2/N3/M3 envelope this rule binds
use_cases.stack: DGS001 FPGA module (Artix-7 class) · India-trained semantic perception · per-object TTC and confidence · CAN / automotive Ethernet object interface · diagnostics and degradation reporting · ASIC from H1 2028 for margin, not for entry
use_cases.systems: Tier-1 AEBS ECU · EBS/ABS actuation · cluster HMI · vehicle CAN
use_cases.users: Tier-1 ADAS system engineer · functional-safety manager · OEM chief engineer
use_cases.orgs: Braking Tier-1 (ZF CVCS, Aptiv or equivalent) · CV OEM · ARAI / ICAT
use_cases.risks: No published ISO 26262 pathway. Until an assessor is engaged the integrator is comparing a certified 5m-unit incumbent with an uncertified newcomer, and no perception result closes that gap.
use_cases.gate: A braking Tier-1 accepts the interface, diagnostics, safety assumptions and validation plan in a written technical exchange, with a recorded go/no-go.

detail.why_now: Design-in for an OEM programme runs 18–30 months and it is August 2026, so the 1 Jan 2027 new-model date is already unwinnable. The addressable date is 1 Oct 2027 all-models and the model-year cycles behind it, both of which are reached through a Tier-1 already nominated on a programme — not through a direct OEM approach.
scope_in: Object detection, classification and tracking in the forward path
Per-target range, range-rate, TTC and in-path probability
Per-object confidence, sensor-health and availability state
Documented interface contract, timing determinism and failure behaviour
scope_out: The braking decision and its arbitration
Brake actuation, EBS integration and calibration
Vehicle-level homologation, type approval and warranty
The AEBS safety case, which the actuator owner will not transfer
data_requirements: India highway corpus at GVW load states across day, night, monsoon and dust
Scenario stratification by target type: M1 saloon, truck rear, bus rear, three-wheeler, two-wheeler, pedestrian, cattle
Ground-truth range from an independent reference (RTK or radar witness), not from the camera under test
Explicit coverage of the AIS-162 §6.8 false-reaction geometry
detail.integration: Object list published on CAN or automotive Ethernet at a fixed cycle with bounded latency and an explicit staleness flag. Interface, timing and degradation semantics must be frozen in a written contract with the Tier-1 before any bench claim is repeated to an OEM.
metrics: Warning-issue time versus the 1.4 s and 0.8 s budget, measured at the interface, not at the HMI
Detection recall by target class and range band, stratified by lighting and weather
Range and range-rate error against the independent reference
End-to-end perception latency, worst case not mean
detail.commercial: Priced as a bounded function inside the Tier-1's bill of materials. State the cost position as cannibalisation immunity — no global ASP to defend, so the India function can carry an India price. Never as a multiple against any competitor's system price.
open_questions: The AIS-162 Annex 3 speed-reduction and target-speed pass/fail values are unresolved in the draft copies retrieved and must be read off the ARAI-published standard before any claim is made against them (EV-162-08).
Which braking Tier-1 will accept a second-source perception layer, given STRADVISION supplies through Aptiv and ZF owns its own stack.

use_cases.arena: Segment B and C · the one lever whose result is still open
use_cases.dates: gates every AEBS approval from 1 Jan 2027
use_cases.title: The claim still available is the false alarm, not the detection
use_cases.challenge: Four rivals already claim India tuning — Aptiv publishes Indian object classes, STRADVISION cites dense mixed traffic, Netrasemi is Indian silicon, Starkenn markets Made-in-India. India-native is no longer a differentiator. What no competitor has published is a measured nuisance rate, and AIS-162 tests for exactly that: pass between two stationary vehicles at 50 km/h over 60 m, in silence.
use_cases.solution: Instrument DGS001 for the denominator rather than the headline. Publish a scenario-stratified false-positive rate per 1,000 km against a named baseline on the same SoC class, the same functions and the same test set. This is the one lever in the STRADVISION contest whose result is genuinely open.
how: Define the India nuisance set: overtaking two-wheelers, cut-in three-wheelers, cattle, roadside encroachment, unlit stationary trucks, wrong-way traffic, kerbside vending
Log every trigger and every non-trigger with scenario tags across the three paid pilots, with telemetry rights secured in the contract
Score false positives per 1,000 km and true-positive recall stratified by scenario, lighting and monsoon
Publish at equal scope; withhold any comparison that silently changes what is being compared
stats: the pass the module must survive in silence
no warning, no emergency braking, or it fails
by any competitor in the retrieved corpus
use_cases.stack: Scenario-tagged telemetry logger · India nuisance-event taxonomy · stratified scoring harness with named denominators · independent ARAI or ICAT characterisation protocol · annotation pipeline
use_cases.systems: Pilot-fleet telemetry backhaul · event and video capture · annotation and review tooling
use_cases.users: Head of Validation · Tier-1 evaluation engineer · fleet safety manager
use_cases.orgs: ARAI or ICAT · three paid pilot fleets · the braking Tier-1 running the evaluation
use_cases.risks: A nuisance rate without a denominator is marketing. If the scenario mix, kilometres and baseline are not fixed in advance, the result cannot be defended in a Tier-1 review and will be discounted to zero.
use_cases.gate: One published equal-scope benchmark: named baseline, same SoC class, same function set, same test set, with scenario-stratified denominators and an independent test agency's protocol.

detail.why_now: This is the only differentiator in the portfolio that is not already occupied or already behind. Functional safety is a deficit to close; deployed scale cannot be argued at all against ~5m cumulative SVNet units. Constrained-compute cost and nuisance behaviour on Indian roads are the two contests where the result is not yet written, and the second is cheaper to prove.
scope_in: The AIS-162 §6.8 false-reaction geometry as a first-class test case, not an afterthought
An India nuisance taxonomy with per-scenario denominators
Recall reported alongside every false-positive figure, so suppression cannot be bought with blindness
Independent protocol authorship by ARAI or ICAT
scope_out: Any claim of a multiple against a competitor
Any figure quoted without its kilometre and scenario denominator
data_requirements: Three paid instrumented pilots with telemetry rights secured before the first vehicle is fitted
Scenario tags applied at capture, not reconstructed afterwards
Both trigger and non-trigger events retained — a log of alerts alone cannot produce a rate
Night, monsoon and dust coverage proportional to real fleet exposure
detail.integration: The logger must not alter the perception path under test. Capture at the interface, timestamped against the same clock as the object list, with sufficient buffer to reconstruct the seconds preceding every event.
metrics: False positives per 1,000 km, stratified by scenario, lighting and weather
True-positive recall by target class at the same operating point
Driver-disable rate on pilot vehicles — the field measure that Renault and AB Dynamics both name as the failure mode
Inter-annotator agreement on scenario tags, so the denominator is itself defensible
detail.commercial: The benchmark is not a product; it is the artifact that makes every other use case sellable. Fund it as evidence, and price the pilots for telemetry rights rather than for revenue.
open_questions: Whether a braking Tier-1 will accept a supplier-run benchmark at all, or require the test agency to hold the protocol from the start.
What baseline is nameable without breaching the ban on competitor pricing and scope-mismatched comparison.

use_cases.arena: Segment B · OEM line-fit, and Segment A retrofit
use_cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
use_cases.title: Two-thirds of India's road deaths are the road users these two standards were written for
use_cases.challenge: Two-wheeler riders were 46.2% of India's 1,77,175 road deaths in 2024 and pedestrians 20.6% — together 1.28 lakh people. AIS-186 demands an information signal 15 m before the expected collision point with a cyclist on the passenger side, and forbids manual deactivation. AIS-187 demands detection of VRUs crossing at 3–5 km/h inside a 3.7 m forward plane.
use_cases.solution: One India-trained perception core, two output contracts: near-field side and near-field front. Same silicon and same corpus, different detection geometry and signal timing. These are the two functions where India's VRU mix is the requirement itself rather than an edge case bolted onto a Western baseline.
how: Side and front near-field cameras into DGS001; classify pedestrian, adult cyclist and child cyclist
BSIS: project turn geometry including the counter-turn, raise the information signal at least 15 m before the collision point and hold it through the manoeuvre
MOIS: detect VRUs crossing at 3–5 km/h and cyclists parallel at 0–10 km/h inside the 3.7 m plane; hold the signal through a standstill until 15 m past the stopping point
Pass the false-information tests, including the BSIS traffic-sign case
stats: pedestrians and two-wheeler riders — 1.28 lakh people
before the expected collision point, non-deactivable
the close-proximity blind spot in front of the cab
use_cases.stack: DGS001 · near-field VRU classifier · turn-geometry and counter-turn projection · non-deactivable signal logic · optical HMI driver at ~40° off axis · false-information rejection
use_cases.systems: Side and front camera set · driver HMI · turn indicator and steering angle on CAN · vehicle speed
use_cases.users: OEM cab and body engineer · Tier-1 HMI owner · fleet safety officer · driver
use_cases.orgs: CV OEM · bus body builder · state transport undertaking · ARAI / ICAT
use_cases.risks: The BSIS information signal cannot be switched off, so a high nuisance rate here is not merely annoying — it is permanently in the driver's peripheral vision. UC-02's denominator work is a prerequisite, not a parallel track.
use_cases.gate: A characterised near-field detection result against the AIS-186 and AIS-187 test geometries, with the false-information cases run, from an independent agency rather than a bench demonstration.

detail.why_now: BSIS and MOIS bind on the same 1 Oct 2027 / 1 Jan 2028 clock as LDWS and DDAWS, which means four functions arrive together and every CV OEM must source them together. A supplier that can carry more than one of the four with a single core is easier to nominate than four separate suppliers — and this is the pair with the strongest India-specific argument.
scope_in: Near-field detection and classification of pedestrians, adult cyclists and child cyclists
Turn-geometry projection including the counter-turn that begins ~15 m before a narrow turn
Signal persistence through standstill and until 15 m past the stopping point
False-information rejection, including static roadside objects such as traffic signs
scope_out: The HMI hardware and its homologation
Mirror and indirect-vision compliance, which is a separate regulatory stream
Any autonomous steering or braking response to a VRU detection
data_requirements: Indian urban and semi-urban turn scenarios with real cyclist and pedestrian behaviour, not staged crossings alone
Child-cyclist coverage, which is explicitly in the MOIS scope and rarely in a Western corpus
Cab-geometry variation across Indian truck and bus body types — the blind-spot boundary is vehicle-specific
Static-object negatives sufficient to demonstrate false-information rejection
detail.integration: The blind-spot boundary is a function of cab geometry, so the detection zone must be parameterised per vehicle type and set during fitment, not compiled in. Signal placement at approximately 40° off the driver's forward axis is a recommendation the standard justifies at length; deviating from it requires written justification at type approval.
metrics: Signal-activation distance against the 15 m requirement, per test case
Detection rate for adult and child cyclists across the 0–10 km/h parallel band
Crossing-VRU detection across the 3–5 km/h band inside the 3.7 m plane
False-information rate against static roadside objects, reported per hour of urban driving
detail.commercial: The strongest retrofit candidate in the portfolio, because it needs no brake actuation and therefore no braking Tier-1. That makes it the function most naturally paired with Segment A tenders in UC-06.
open_questions: Whether AIS-186 and AIS-187 as published by ARAI diverge from the UN instruments they mirror in test-case tables — the retrieved copies are the UN texts and the ARAI April 2024 BSIS print.
Whether a single DGS001 module can carry both near-field contracts plus UC-01's forward path within the FPGA's real compute ceiling.

use_cases.arena: Segment B line-fit · Segment C fleet retrofit
use_cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
use_cases.title: The only mandated function whose approval evidence is a human-subject study, not a track run
use_cases.challenge: AIS-184 binds M2/M3/N2/N3 above 60 km/h design speed. Approval is not a track test: the manufacturer must run at least ten participants, none from the development team, in both day and night, generating ten or more true-positive or false-negative events, and report per-participant sensitivity with its standard deviation. Over-speeding drove 70.3% of India's 2024 road deaths; fatigue on long-haul highway runs is its companion.
use_cases.solution: An in-cab drowsiness pipeline on the same DGS001 core, delivered together with the validation study that makes it approvable. The differentiator here is not the model. It is being the supplier who hands the integrator a completed AIS-184 documentation package instead of a demonstration.
how: In-cab infrared camera into DGS001: eyelid closure, gaze, head pose and PERCLOS-class metrics, working at night
Fuse with vehicle signals — reduced steering micro-corrections paired with larger, faster corrections, and lateral lane-position variability
Warn above KSS level 8, optionally from level 7; escalate visual then acoustic per the HMI specification
Run the ten-participant day-and-night study and deliver metrics, thresholds, activation speed, weather limits and the statistical analysis
stats: the drowsiness level at which an alert is required
none of whom may have developed the system
use_cases.stack: DGS001 · IR in-cab imaging · PERCLOS, gaze and head-pose metrics · CAN steering and lane-position fusion · KSS-referenced thresholding · AIS-184 documentation package
use_cases.systems: Cab camera mount · cluster HMI · vehicle CAN · fleet telematics for retrofit
use_cases.users: Fleet safety manager · driver · OEM homologation engineer · testing-agency assessor
use_cases.orgs: CV OEM · ARAI or ICAT · fleet operator · the ten-participant study cohort
use_cases.risks: Intra-city buses, school buses and double-deckers are outside AIS-184 scope unless the manufacturer opts in. Sizing this use case against all M2/M3 volume overstates it, and an urban-bus fleet is the wrong first pilot.
use_cases.gate: A completed ten-participant day-and-night validation study with per-participant sensitivity and standard deviation, plus the full documentation package a testing agency can assess.

detail.why_now: AIS-184 is the one function in the portfolio where the approval bottleneck is a study rather than silicon, so it can be started before qualified silicon exists and while the FPGA module is the only hardware. It converts calendar time into an artifact a testing agency recognises.
scope_in: Driver-state estimation from in-cab imaging plus vehicle-signal fusion
KSS-referenced thresholding with documented activation and deactivation logic
The validation study design, execution and statistical analysis
The documentation package specified in AIS-184 Part 2
scope_out: Driver identification, alcohol interlock and behavioural scoring — adjacent products, different buyers
Any claim of distraction detection beyond what the standard defines
data_requirements: Ten or more participants matching the target demography and licensed for the vehicle class, none from the development team
Day and night sessions with at least one true positive recorded in each condition
Ground-truth drowsiness scoring — sleep-video analysis or an equivalent the agency will accept
Weather conditions documented, including strong rain and high temperature, with stated system behaviour
detail.integration: The system must analyse vehicle signals as well as the driver, so steering-angle and lane-position access on CAN is a hard dependency, not an enhancement. The HMI must escalate through documented modes and the deactivation logic must be defensible at type approval.
metrics: Average sensitivity across participants, with its standard deviation, per the standard's statistical method
True-positive and false-negative counts per participant, day and night
False-alert rate per driving hour, which the standard does not bound but the fleet will
Performance retention with spectacles, beards, headwear and varied cab lighting
detail.commercial: The documentation package is the product surface a fleet or OEM cannot easily assemble itself. Sell the study alongside the module and the deal becomes a compliance service, not a component purchase.
open_questions: Whether the participant cohort can be assembled from pilot-fleet drivers without breaching the rule that none may be involved in system development.
Whether the agency will accept a supplier-run study for a component, or require it re-run at vehicle level by the OEM.

use_cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
use_cases.title: The function India's road surface makes hardest and the mandate makes unavoidable
use_cases.challenge: 58.6% of India's 2024 road deaths were on national and state highways that are roughly 5% of the network, and 67.6% of accidents happened on straight roads — precisely where LDWS applies. Yet markings on those corridors are worn, inconsistent or absent, and Indian lane discipline is informal by design. A stack tuned on painted European lanes alerts continuously here, and a continuously alerting LDWS gets switched off.
use_cases.solution: Lane estimation that does not depend on a painted line. Road edge, kerb, median, worn marking and vehicle-flow cues fused into a drivable-corridor estimate, with departure thresholds that move with traffic density and speed rather than sitting fixed.
how: Forward camera into DGS001: segment lane marking, road edge, kerb and median, and estimate marking quality
Estimate the drivable corridor and lateral position when no marking is visible
Modulate the departure threshold by traffic density and speed; suppress during indicated manoeuvres
Emit the departure event with confidence, plus an explicit temporarily-unavailable state when the corridor cannot be estimated
stats: on NH and SH — about 5% of the road network
the road feature where LDWS is the applicable function
under rule 98(6), with all models on 1 Jan 2028
use_cases.stack: DGS001 · marking-independent corridor estimation · marking-quality assessment · density-adaptive thresholds · availability-state reporting · manoeuvre suppression on indicator
use_cases.systems: Forward camera · cluster HMI for haptic or acoustic warning · CAN speed, indicator and steering angle
use_cases.users: OEM chassis and ADAS engineer · Tier-1 integrator · long-haul driver
use_cases.orgs: CV OEM · Tier-1 · highway fleet operators · ARAI / ICAT
use_cases.risks: Declaring the function unavailable too readily is the easy way to pass a nuisance target and the fast way to fail type approval. Availability rate must be reported next to the false-alert rate or neither number means anything.
use_cases.gate: A measured corridor-estimation and departure-alert result on unmarked and degraded Indian highway sections, reporting availability rate alongside false-alert rate.

detail.why_now: LDWS shares the 1 Oct 2027 / 1 Jan 2028 clock with DDAWS, BSIS and MOIS. It is also the cheapest of the four to demonstrate from an existing forward camera, so it is the natural second function to offer a Tier-1 already evaluating UC-01 — the same sensor, the same module, one more contract.
scope_in: Lane, edge, kerb and median segmentation with an explicit marking-quality estimate
Corridor estimation where no marking exists
Density- and speed-adaptive departure thresholds
Availability and degradation state as a first-class output
scope_out: Lane keeping, lane centring and emergency lane keeping (AIS-191 ELKS) — adjacent and separately regulated
Map or localisation dependence, which would import an infrastructure obligation DeepGrid cannot meet
data_requirements: NH and SH sections stratified by marking condition: fresh, worn, partial, absent
Monsoon, night, glare and dust coverage on the same sections
Dense mixed-traffic segments where lateral position is negotiated rather than held
Ground-truth lateral position from an independent reference on a sample of runs
detail.integration: The unavailable state must be visible to the driver as a constant yellow signal in the same manner the AEBS standard requires for temporary unavailability, so the HMI contract with the OEM must cover it explicitly rather than treating it as an internal diagnostic.
metrics: Availability rate by marking condition — the number that stops nuisance suppression being bought with silence
False-alert rate per 100 km on unmarked sections
Departure-detection latency against lateral crossing
Driver-disable rate on pilot vehicles
detail.commercial: Sell as the second function on an existing forward camera rather than as a standalone product. Incremental compute on an already-nominated module is a far easier conversation than a new sensor.
open_questions: Whether AIS-188 as published defines an availability obligation, or leaves it to the manufacturer's declaration — the register still lists it as a draft.
Whether corridor estimation without markings can meet a type-approval test written around marked lanes at all.

use_cases.arena: Segment A · government, PSU and defence — the only arena transactable today
use_cases.dates: transactable now · does not wait for 2027
use_cases.title: The only arena that can transact before qualified silicon exists in H1 2028
use_cases.challenge: DGS001 is an FPGA module. The ASIC tapes out Q1 to mid 2027 and qualified volume silicon lands H1 2028 — after the 1 Oct 2027 all-models date. OEM design-in runs 18 to 30 months, so line-fit revenue cannot arrive first. Every rupee before H1 2028 must come from the FPGA module, and only one arena gates on eligibility rather than certification.
use_cases.solution: Package DGS001 as a GeM-listed, Class-I local-content perception kit for state transport undertakings and PSU fleets. At 50% or more local content DeepGrid is a Class-I local supplier with a 20% margin of purchase preference — and where a nodal ministry certifies sufficient local capacity, only Class-I suppliers may bid at all.
how: Compute and document local content at or above 50%, self-certified with the locations of value addition
List on GeM with country of origin and local-content percentage, qualifying for the Make in India filter
Bid into STU, PSU and municipal tenders that are reserved for, or preference-weighted toward, Class-I suppliers
Instrument every delivered unit and secure telemetry rights in the supply contract — these units are the evidence engine for UC-02
stats: the threshold that makes DeepGrid a Class-I local supplier
over a non-Class-I lowest bid, with a right to match
everything before it is FPGA-module revenue
use_cases.stack: DGS001 FPGA module · Class-I local-content dossier and self-certification · GeM catalogue listing · depot fitment and calibration procedure · telemetry rights written into the supply contract
use_cases.systems: GeM portal · fleet telematics backhaul · depot fitment and calibration · tender documentation workflow
use_cases.users: STU procurement officer · depot engineer · DeepGrid BD · Head of Validation
use_cases.orgs: State transport undertakings · PSU and municipal fleets · defence procurement · GeM · nodal ministry
use_cases.risks: Starkenn already draws about 30% of revenue from government tenders and can underbid on empanelment, where eligibility rather than certification decides. Class-I status is winnable but slowly, and a nodal ministry may prescribe local content above 50%.
use_cases.gate: A GeM listing live with a documented local-content percentage at or above 50%, and one tender bid submitted under Class-I preference with telemetry rights in the draft contract.

detail.why_now: This is a sequencing conclusion, not a market preference. The ASIC is a margin event that lands after the mandate's final date, so the FPGA module has to carry the company through the window. Segment A is the only arena where the gate is eligibility — which DeepGrid can satisfy — rather than certification, which it cannot yet.
scope_in: Local-content computation, documentation and self-certification under PPP-MII
GeM catalogue listing and Make in India filter qualification
Retrofit-suitable packaging of the near-field functions from UC-03, which need no brake actuation
Telemetry rights as a contract term, not a request after delivery
scope_out: Any AEBS or brake-actuating claim — Segment A retrofit does not reach actuation and must not be sold as if it does
Any statement of prior ADAS or defence revenue: ₹23.01L was delivered, ₹78.39L is L1 and not an award, it sits in a different legal entity and the IP is MCEME-owned
Competing on price in warning-only retrofit, where the functional-safety pathway buys nothing
data_requirements: A bill of materials with imported content valued inclusive of customs duty, per the Order's definition
Named locations of value addition, as the self-certification requires
Tender-eligibility history for the target STUs and PSUs
Confirmation of whether the nodal ministry has prescribed local content above the 50% default
detail.integration: Depot fitment and calibration is the delivery constraint, not the module. The average Indian M&HCV is around ten years old and aftermarket calibration capability is a named readiness gap across the whole industry — treat installer capacity as a gating resource in the bid, not an afterthought.
metrics: Local-content percentage, computed and auditable
Tenders where Class-I preference was applicable, bid, and won
Units delivered with telemetry rights secured — the input to UC-02
Fielded kilometres per month, which is the statement that eventually answers deployed-scale objections
detail.commercial: Price the function at the India price, argued as cannibalisation immunity. The 20% purchase-preference margin is real headroom against a non-Class-I lowest bid and should be planned into the bid strategy rather than discovered at award.
open_questions: Whether the relevant nodal ministry has notified sufficient local capacity for this item, which would exclude non-Class-I bidders entirely and change the competitive set.
Whether telemetry rights survive a standard STU contract template, or need to be negotiated as a deviation.

sequencing: UC-06 listing prepared · UC-02 taxonomy and protocol drafted with ARAI or ICAT · ISO 26262 assessor engaged as a procurement action
UC-01 technical exchange opened with a braking Tier-1 · three paid pilots contracted with telemetry rights · UC-04 study cohort assembled
UC-02 first stratified result published · UC-06 first Class-I bid submitted · written go/no-go recorded from the Tier-1 exchange
do_not_fund: A full-stack braking safety case · broad OEM customisation · a radar programme of any kind · any performance marketing not backed by a measured result. Release capital only when partner access, field telemetry and a primary qualification artifact clear together.
